- pmid: 36215666
    study_label: "Sarango 2022 — HeLa-CIITA T6BP/autophagy"
    arm_resolution: multi_arm_evidence
    arm_resolution_note: >
      Exact single-condition statements, including antibody-qualified variants,
      identify 3,632 Mock, 1,156 siCTRL and 2,233 siT6BP observations. The remaining
      7,882 rows explicitly name multiple arms and retain unknown arm identity.
    title: "The Autophagy Receptor TAX1BP1 (T6BP) improves antigen presentation by MHC-II molecules"
    override: cell_line
    note: >
      HeLa-CIITA cells (cervical carcinoma + stable CIITA transduction for
      forced class II expression). PMC9724678 Figure 3 and Figure EV2 profile
      Mock, siCTRL and siT6BP in BOTH class I (W6/32 IP) and class II (TÜ39 IP).
      The immunopeptidome methods explicitly support HLA-DRB1*01:02. Exact
      endogenous class-I alleles previously copied here lack verified provenance
      for this derivative and are withdrawn; class-I typing remains unspecified.
      IEDB source
      annotation "healthy cervix" is misleading for disease state — HeLa is
      cervical adenocarcinoma, not healthy tissue — though IEDB's cervix /
      HeLa cell_name annotations are otherwise correct (paper-verified). The
      paper uses a panel of autophagy-receptor siRNAs (NDP52, OPTN, T6BP;
      p62 and CANX in follow-up experiments); the T6BP vs control contrast
      is the headline MS result showing T6BP silencing reduces the MHC-II
      immunopeptidome without affecting MHC-I.
    perturbations:
      - "CIITA transduction (forced HLA-II expression)"
      - "TAX1BP1 (T6BP) siRNA knockdown in MS experiment"

  - pmid: 24366607
    study_label: "Marcilla 2014 — HLA-B*40:02 phosphopeptidome"
    title: "Increased diversity of the HLA-B40 ligandome by the presentation of peptides phosphorylated at their main anchor residue"
    override: cell_line
    mono_allelic_host: "C1R"
    note: >
      C1R-B*40:02 transfectant profiled as a mono-allelic HLA-I ligandome
      with targeted phosphopeptide enrichment. The source paper reports more
      than 2,000 unique HLA-B*40:02 ligands and 85 validated phospholigands
      after sequential IMAC + TiO2 enrichment. Current IEDB rows for this
      PMID are cleanly allele-resolved: 2,318 class I observations, all
      HLA-B*40:02, almost entirely annotated as C1R cells.
    ip_antibody: W6/32
    ms_samples:
      - sample_label: "C1R-HLA-B*40:02"
        n_samples: 1
        source: "C1R cells transfected with single HLA-B*40:02 allele; ~10^10 cells"
        condition: "unperturbed — mono-allelic phosphopeptidome (IMAC + TiO2 enrichment)"
        condition_id: "c1r_hla_b_40_02"
        condition_status: "annotated"
        condition_evidence: "curated_text"
        condition_control: "untreated"
        condition_mhc_context: "monoallelic"
        mhc_class: "I"
        mhc: "HLA-B*40:02"
